summary: Implemented closeout gate directive-link validation and preservation. Closeout gate satisfaction and forced-gate metadata now carry directiveIds and acknowledgementIds, gate views and directive snapshots preserve those links, and import/export rejects dangling gate directive references when directive bundles are present.
command: pnpm exec tsc -b packages/core/tsconfig.json packages/engine/tsconfig.json apps/cli/tsconfig.json --pretty false AND pnpm exec vitest run tests/runtime/import-export-directives.test.ts tests/runtime/core.test.ts tests/runtime/runtime-flow.test.ts tests/runtime/agent-directive-snapshot.test.ts tests/runtime/agent-directive-compiler.test.ts tests/runtime/agent-directive-runtime-integration.test.ts AND pnpm exec vitest run tests/runtime/cli-agent-directives.test.ts AND pnpm exec vitest run tests/runtime/cli.test.ts -t 'runs golden-path agent aliases and closeout gates' AND bwrk sync refresh --json AND bwrk doctor --strict --json
